increment.observedProblem: Immutable v2.0 closed the core contract but its public presentation still used collective publisher metadata, a generic icon, a dense reader path and a full-release label stronger than the finite test corpus supports. Treating those distribution-only changes as a new behavior contract would wastefully invalidate unchanged Skill evidence, while optimizing only for repository size could erase user-valued predecessor capabilities instead of reducing their implementation weight. The underlying long-lived problem is neither a missing simulated human nor a model that this project can replace: finite people and finite Agents still lose intent, context, initiative and shared state at their collaboration boundary.
increment.hypothesis: A Public Preview distribution can preserve the v2.0 behavior contract and evidence while independently binding the complete v2.0.1-preview.1 package, personal publisher identity, trademark asset, reader path and activation lifecycle. A thin progressively disclosed collaboration layer can retain goal anchoring, routing, authority, reconciliation, continuity, recovery, verification and cleanup without requiring the Agent to imitate a human or restoring an always-on Runtime, Hook, MCP, App or state layer. Its value is judged by reliable delivery and lower net human burden, not anthropomorphic behavior or mechanism count.

orderedGates.condition: One locally committed clean candidate preserves the v2.0 contract and claim-relevant representative evidence while aligning the complete v2.0.1-preview.1 distribution, authority, verifier, reference projections, documentation and tests; all eight repository criteria are satisfied and no known blocker or task residue remains.

On the unchanged clean local candidate, the active goal carrier directly runs the canonical verifier, both host checks, full product tests, diff, identity, link, workflow and residue checks plus independent specification, implementation-robustness and standards-conformance review. An independent human or second observation surface compares the publishable source bundle with the original host or session records, and one evaluator isolated from candidate-preparation context completes a clean-state README activation, confirmation and removal walkthrough. The sample is context-isolated, outcome-bound, identity-neutral and internal only; the accountable user, a colleague or a second observation surface may execute it. Any P0/P1 blocks the gate. Repository self-report cannot satisfy it, and only after it passes may the same SHA be pushed.

After push, the active goal carrier directly verifies the unchanged clean HEAD on every required hosted system. For this Public Preview ordinary Codex Cloud is required; Linux, Windows and macOS GitHub Actions are attempted when account quota is available, while quota-limited absence remains explicit unknown external state and is neither a pass nor a product failure. Repository self-report and earlier revisions are insufficient.

Only after exact hosted verification, present the unchanged SHA, complete claim ceiling, retained failures and continuing evidence lanes to a named accountable human; the decision must preserve a real veto and is not written into the candidate.

Create the lightweight v2.0.1-preview.1 tag and GitHub prerelease only after required hosted verification and exact named-human authorization for the unchanged candidate; do not move the tag or attach assets.

The active goal carrier directly verifies the public prerelease flag, remote and local v2.0.1-preview.1 tag, exact tracked release notes and zero-asset policy; it then removes task-created resources, confirms repository and evaluator residue are absent, and replays local validation.

releaseProcedure.rule: Execute gates strictly in listed order. A failure, material correction, later rule or revision returns to the earliest affected dependency boundary; only evidence that depends on that boundary and its downstream gates is superseded, while unrelated accepted truth remains stable. Public Preview quota-limited optional hosted systems remain unknown, not passed or failed. No report, plan, test, commit, push, hosted pass or authorization is promoted into a later effect.

goalModePrompt.hostLifecycleNote: Immutable v2.0 at 71ff4a2687b54f26c8dbf3a94384257f1fc0f532 retains its seven exact behavior observations and GT-07 cleanup exclusion. The user clarified that the predecessor's purpose and outcome capabilities remain valid while its always-loaded implementation was too heavy for small-context Agents; the current review therefore challenges premises, interfaces and representations while considering deletion, replacement, recomposition, native delegation and bounded addition. The retained mechanism uses the Git index as its finite declaration source, shared Python 3.10 AST grammar, linear bounded static-subtree summaries, strict non-Python decoding, exact lexical identity boundaries, descriptor-bound stable regular-file reads, bounded Git capture, exact workflow structure and structured source-evidence constraints. It fails closed on indeterminate declared surfaces and exempts only digest-bound research Markdown plus exact tracked PNG paths whose signature and complete bytes match program-declared SHA-256 values. The corrected checkpoint measures 184587 product-code-and-test bytes and 58 tracked files. The reviewed targets are 195000 bytes and 60 files, leaving 10413 bytes against the required 9750-byte reserve and two file slots. These are evidence-triggered recalibrations, not automatic growth. Any future breach blocks Q3 and triggers premise, interface and representation review across deletion, replacement, recomposition, native delegation and bounded addition. There is no universal add-or-subtract default; L2 still requires a deletion or replacement attempt before another same-purpose repair layer, and any mechanism is simplified or retired when its residual value is no longer demonstrated.

processLossControl.carrierRule: Use current source-bound host signals when reliable; if capacity is unavailable, record unknown and transition conservatively. No universal turn count, context size, token percentage or summary ratio is product authority.
processLossControl.correctionRule: A material correction, failure, later rule or revision supersedes affected current-candidate evidence from the earliest dependency boundary and requires that boundary and every downstream gate to be replayed while unrelated accepted truth remains stable. A repeated correction or failed same-purpose mechanism pauses the current shape until premise, interface and representation are reconsidered; deletion, replacement, recomposition, native-host delegation and bounded addition are all considered. There is no universal add-or-subtract default, while L2 requires a deletion or replacement attempt before another same-purpose repair layer. Authority surfaces form a reviewable versioned current set; their merge, split, replacement or retirement requires explicit provenance-preserving schema and verifier migration plus the same earliest-boundary replay.
processLossControl.continuingCalibration: Post-release failures may update Golden Tasks, narrow a claim, simplify or retire a projection, or open one new bounded increment; release status does not freeze learning.
